title: NEET row: CBI claims NTA experts breached 'secrecy pact', face life term, Rs 1cr fine
content: The integrity of the NEET-UG 2026 examination was compromised as three NTA subject experts were reportedly involved in leaking confidential question papers. The CBI has taken action by filing a chargesheet against them in a Delhi court. Accused of engaging in criminal conspiracy and cheating under recently established laws, these individuals may face severe repercussions, including substantial fines and potential life imprisonment.

title: 'Unnecessary pressure': Ex-cricketer questions Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's vice-captaincy
content: Former Gujarat captain Priyank Panchal expressed skepticism regarding Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's recent appointment as vice-captain for the upcoming Duleep Trophy. The young talent, aged just 15, will support Ishan Kishan in this significant role. Sooryavanshi earned recognition after his Player of the Series performance in Zimbabwe, leading selectors to justify their choice as part of a broader development strategy. The tournament kicks off on August 23 in Bengaluru.

title: India counters China's 'map war', assigns official names to 27 Arunachal sites
content: India ahs onsistently rejected Beijing's practice of assigning Chinese names to places in Arunachal Pradesh, describing the exercise as "vain and preposterous". India has maintained that such actions do not change the "undeniable" fact that the state "was, is, and will" remain an integral part of the country. Several of the newly marked locations hold strategic importance because of their proximity to the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

title: Elon Musk's preferred state halts data center approvals; says 'prove' this
content: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has ordered a temporary halt to new data center approvals.  Regulators must complete a comprehensive audit before projects can move forward.  Developers must prove electricity and water use, and tax incentives.  Abbott stated Texans must come first in all state decisions.  This move addresses growing scrutiny over rapid data center expansion.

title: Rohit, Kohli too old for 2027 World Cup? Shikhar Dhawan drops verdict
content: Now playing only ODI cricket, Rohit and Kohli had a productive series against England in July, despite India losing the three-match series 2-1.

title: AI creating more jobs in India than cuts: Nomura report
content: According to the report by Nomura Holdings Inc, AI-driven recruitment continues to be more than job losses in the country. Given the country's vast workforce, India is experiencing the "largest absolute impact" of AI across layoffs, hiring freezes and recruitment.

title: Google warns Blackstone, Bridgewater, Bain, KKR, TPG, Moody’s of phone hack
content: Recent reports from Google reveal that hackers have set their sights on prominent US financial companies, employing cunning phone scams to extract sensitive credentials from employees. Following this, they launched customized malicious websites designed specifically for each target. Shifting their attention to private equity firms, these assailants have allegedly compelled some businesses to pay ransoms after committing data theft.

title: Islamic Nato taking shape? What Saudi-Pak-Turkey Mecca pact means for Iran & Israel
content: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey signed a new defence pact in Mecca. This agreement commits them to mutual defence against any armed attack. The deal combines Saudi financial power, Turkish defence industry, and Pakistan's military strength. It comes amid regional tensions involving Iran, Israel, and the United States. This pact signals a shift towards regional security architecture development.

title: Billionaire couple offers $150M to make San Francisco better to live in
content: Billionaires Michael Moritz and Harriet Heyman have launched an ambitious $150 million initiative aimed at enhancing San Francisco. Through their foundation, Crankstart, they invite innovative solutions to tackle urgent housing and economic challenges. Organizations can compete for funding, with the evaluation process culminating in a decision set for autumn 2027. This competition highlights the city's increasing dependency on private philanthropy in addressing critical public needs.

title: Strangers rebuild Cumberland mother’s stolen farm stand for free
content: On its inaugural night, a mother’s bakery stand faced an unfortunate theft. However, a compassionate construction duo—a father and son team—came to the rescue, reconstructing the entire stand at no cost. They meticulously followed the original design, delivering a perfect replica within a week. With security enhancements now in place, the bakery has officially reopened, bringing sweet treats back to the community.

title: Michael Dell's son Zach Dell wants his Base Power batteries in every American backyard
content: Zach Dell's company Base Power is expanding its home battery business across America.  The company offers a unique membership model, replacing high upfront costs.  Base Power recently secured one billion dollars in new funding, valuing it at thirteen billion.  This expansion includes plans for international markets like the United Kingdom and Germany.  The firm is also increasing its battery manufacturing capacity to meet growing demand.

title: Manchester City reject Barcelona's opening offer for Rodri
content: Manchester City have rejected Barcelona's opening £38.5 million bid for Rodri, valuing the Ballon d'Or-winning midfielder at over £60 million. With Rodri entering the final year of his contract, uncertainty over his future continues. Barcelona remain interested, while City are already exploring potential replacements if the Spain international departs.

title: Roman Reigns vs. Brock Lesnar net worth in 2026: WWE salaries, earnings & more
content: Roman Reigns and Brock Lesnar have contributed to the modern era of WWE. Mostly, with blockbuster rivalries, championship reigns and record-breaking paydays. Reigns is currently the highest-paid on WWE’s active payroll, but Lesnar has made his fortune through WWE, UFC, and premium appearances. An all-out comparison of their projected net worth, career earnings, endorsements, business ventures, investments and future earning potential for 2026.

title: Which tennis queen rules Instagram? Serena, Sabalenka & Osaka lead social race

Naomi Osaka has 3.2 million followers, sharing genuine life updates and mental health discussions. Emma Raducanu and Coco Gauff also maintain significant fanbases with diverse content. Iga Swiatek rounds out the list with her authentic approach to social media.

title: Ronaldo-Georgina wedding: 7 football stars fans won’t expect, including Messi

However, several prominent football figures, like Wayne Rooney and Lionel Messi, may find themselves excluded from the guest list. Other notable absentees are Erik ten Hag and Gary Lineker.

title: Argentina publicly back Infantino as FIFA president amid World Cup rights row

title: 'We demand that NTA be dissolved': CJP on CBI charge sheet in NEET 2026 case
content: The CBI has filed a chargesheet in the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak case. This investigation implicates several NTA-appointed subject experts in a multi-state conspiracy. Leaked questions were allegedly circulated through intermediaries for financial gain. The Cockroach Janta Party demands the NTA's dissolution and conversion into a new commission. They also seek a thorough probe into all recent paper leaks across India.

title: What a Sri Lanka series win could mean for India's WTC campaign
content: India are currently fifth in the WTC standings with a points percentage of 48.15, while Sri Lanka are sixth with 41.67. Both teams are still within reach of fourth-placed Bangladesh, who have a points percentage of 58.33.

title: Onion, oil or chicken: What made your thali costlier in July
content: In July, the prices for home-cooked thalis surged compared to the previous year, with vegetarian options increasing by four percent and non-vegetarian increasing by nine percent. The rise in costs was driven by expensive onions, vegetable oil, and LPG for vegetarian meals, while non-vegetarian thalis were notably affected by higher broiler chicken prices. Nevertheless, the decline in potato and tomato prices somewhat alleviated these overall increases.

title: 'He's like me, but better': McCullum's verdict on England's new Test coach Fleming

McCullum mentioned that England remains committed to nurturing Brook's leadership abilities. Additionally, Stephen Fleming has taken over as the head coach for the red-ball team and is regarded as an exceptional choice to follow McCullum's lead.

title: Education, jobs, inflation: CJP launches petition asking PM Modi to address India's youth

Highlighting unemployment as a critical national challenge, the party celebrated the recent resignation of the Union Education Minister. With an aim for nationwide growth, the CJP is gearing up for grassroots mobilization to address these concerns.

title: Will you have to pay to use UPI? 7 FAQs on possible MDR & what it means for consumers
content: The government is expected to permit a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) of between 0.25% and 0.4% on UPI transactions above Rs 2,000 made to businesses, while person-to-person payments are likely to remain outside the scope of the proposed levy. The proposal is not expected to affect routine purchases such as milk, vegetables, groceries or payments for auto-rickshaw and taxi services.

title: 'Avoid Lutyens web': PM Modi's advice to 45 NDA MPs at breakfast meet
content: In the meeting, which also included the rebel factions from the Uddhav Sena and Mamata Banerjee's TMC, PM Modi said: "No one should say anything trashy on TV. Maintain full dignity at all times. Engage actively in social media through Facebook, Instagram and X; interact with youth, inform government welfare work, encourage youth for sports activities." Modi advised the MPs to follow the party line and calmly present their views on every issue.

He suggested Kolkata Knight Riders could be a strong contender for Pandya.  Ashwin believes Mumbai must receive significant player value in any deal.  The Mumbai Indians are considering rival team strengthening in trade discussions.

title: Food for thought: Global food prices rise in July as cereals, sugar turn costly
content: In July, global food prices saw a notable rise, with cereals, vegetable oils, and sugar reflecting increased costs. Wheat and maize surged due to weather conditions and market apprehensions. Vegetable oils peaked since June 2022, bolstered by robust demand. Sugar prices also rebounded, driven by weather impacts and expectations around ethanol use. Conversely, meat and dairy prices faced a downturn during this period.

title: Amitabh Bachchan reveals why he has worn tinted glasses for 25 years as he ages

His emotional admission was accompanied by an apology for delays attributed to technical adjustments. The legendary actor is currently enjoying the success of his latest project, Kalki 2898 AD. Read on to know more.

title: 'US itself regulates foreign funds': MEA hits back at American lawmaker's FCRA Bill remark
content: Ministry of external affairs rejected criticism of its foreign funding law.  The ministry stated that legislative matters are internal decisions for Parliament.  Several countries, including the United States, also regulate foreign financing.  A US Congressman criticized proposed amendments to India's Foreign Contribution Regulation Act.  He warned these changes could affect India-US bilateral relations.

title: Rain fury grips Delhi-NCR: Waterlogging cripples commute amid IMD's red alert
content: Delhi and NCR experienced heavy rainfall on Friday morning. Waterlogging affected several areas, including Safdarjung Hospital and the airport. Traffic movement was significantly disrupted across the city and its surroundings. The India Meteorological Department recorded substantial rainfall amounts in various locations. Light rainfall is expected to continue over Delhi for the next two days.

Traffic slowed on major roads, and waterlogging affected key points like Mahipalpur T-Point. The India Meteorological Department issued a red alert, forecasting more rain.

title: US overtakes Gulf as India's biggest LPG supplier after Hormuz disruptions: Report

As a result, the US accounted for 73 per cent of India's LPG imports in July, compared with just 12 per cent in January.
